name: Valen
summary: Varen showcases an Arabescato white marble top, its bold veining giving the piece a striking, sculptural elegance. The body is wrapped in dark grey matte elm veneer, adding refined texture and a grounded, contemporary warmth. Inside, melamine-lined drawers keep the function clean and polished. A metallic brass painted frame completes the design with a rich, luminous edge, giving the whole piece a confident, upscale presence. Top with Arabescato white marble, the body cover with elm veneer in dark gray matt, drawer inside with melamine. metal frame with metallic brass paint. 60×52
